program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j, !is_bos@j & !is_b@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(is_bos@i & !is_bos@j, true)
h2_1 = rightmost(!h1_2@j, !h1_1@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(!h2_1@i & !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & h1_2@j & !h2_1@j, !is_bos@j & h1_2@j & !h2_1@j)
h3_2 = leftmost(h1_1@i & !h2_1@i & !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & h1_1@j & h1_2@j & !h2_1@j, true)
h4_1 = rightmost(h1_1@i & h1_2@i & !h2_1@i & h3_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & h1_1@j & h1_2@j & !h3_1@j & !h3_2@j, h1_2@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j)
h4_2 = leftmost(is_b@i & h1_1@i & h3_2@i & !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & h3_2@j, !is_bos@j)
h5_2 = leftmost(h3_1@i & h3_2@i & !h4_1@i & !h4_1@j, !h4_1@i & !h4_1@j)
h6_2 = leftmost(h5_2@i, !h4_1@i)
accept = !h3_2 & !h4_2 & !h5_2 & !h6_2

output accept
